Follow-up clarification: The symptoms began soon after eating fish. There is flushing with palpitations and headache. This food-triggered timing is the key clue.

I have drooping eyelids, weak speech, and weakness that gets worse the more I use my muscles.

Follow-up clarification: The weakness is fatigable and worsens with exertion. There is ptosis and difficulty speaking. This is more suggestive of myasthenia gravis than Guillain-Barre syndrome.
